import asyncio
import random
from pathlib import Path


for root in (Path("state"),):
    root.read_text()

for Generator in (random.Random,):
    Generator()

for runner in (asyncio.Runner(),):
    runner.get_loop().time()

for root, Generator in ((Path("state"), random.Random),):
    root.read_text()
    Generator()

Factory = int
for item in (random.Random, int):
    Factory()
    Factory = item
